A run of asterisks or underscores next to another asterisk or underscore can open toward it and
close away from it.

b_*a**

\_*a**

a*_b_*

*_a_*b

a**_b_**c

a*_b*

- *(c)\*\*\*\* \*****x's****x's*\_

Beside a tilde the flanking rules alone decide, so a link's strong struck text reads as struck.

[**~~**d**~~**](https://e.com/u)
